title: Represent measurable goal counts explicitly
head: Commit containing this receipt; exact published head and normal hook results recorded in PR description.

dependencies.stack: User-requested F stack on corrected F14, keep PRs open and unmerged.

baseline_review.comparison: Goal application service, types and vault writer match pinned audit and current main. Workflow schema differs only by F08 ingredient pins on the F stack; time_saved_per_run is preserved and not used as a measurement.
baseline_review.parent_ci: Corrected F14 Tests, Docker and active platform checks pass.

figma.visual: Behavior/schema/read adapter only, no presentation activation or screenshot.

implementation: Additive optional goal measurement snapshots, evidence-version deduplication and immutable command receipts in the existing vault.

Canonical GoalApplicationService validates and records absolute user-reported measurements with revision checks, source versions and observation times; score, history and durable events commit atomically.
Legacy 0.6 stays score-only. Unknown and observed zero are distinct; baseline/target mapping supports decreasing targets, overachievement and negative corrections without changing raw counts.
Parent and child scopes are independent, with no inferred rollup or title parsing. Children never add to an already inclusive parent measurement.
Authenticated, bounded, default-off reads/writes and receipt recovery; canonical detail/list/root/tree/children reads expose the same stored measurement.
Configured measured goals reject legacy scores; work results can still be checked without changing goal progress. Canonical goal revisions remain monotonic through health refresh.

fixes: Return actionable 409 for a work-result score that conflicts with a goal measurement.
Retain monotonic canonical goal updated_at after health refresh.

mutations.restored: Exact source bytes restored in finally; focused suite rerun after all variants.

verification.guards: Normal EE, migration, template, package, related tests and TypeScript hooks required before push; exact results in PR description.
verification.manual: Authenticated HTTP via temporary Unix socket, real application writer and two independent writer processes. Synthetic owner reports only; no provider/model/production calls.

limitations: All reports are explicitly user_reported. References are not fetched or certified as provider-verified measurements; automatic review scoring remains refused.
No implicit parent/child rollup. Automatic aggregation requires a separate disjoint-attribution contract.

D09 accepts the six-of-ten wire shape, but live adapters must use the owner progress value for nonzero baselines/decreasing targets instead of the current preview raw ratio. D09/D10/D25 presentation remains unwired.
Older servers do not enforce the measurement-backed score rule. Disable the capability on the new runtime for rollback and retain data; do not downgrade active measurement writers.
F16 outcomes/time-back and F27 reconciliation are not included. Full repository CI reports separately on the PR.
rollback: Unset JARVIS_BRIEF_GOAL_MEASUREMENTS on the new runtime; retain additive measurement, history and receipt tables. Do not reinterpret measurements as inferred counts or downgrade active writers.

findings.R1: Register JARVIS_BRIEF_GOAL_MEASUREMENTS in JARVIS_SETTINGS_ENV_NAMES, fixing the required inventory check and preserving the opt-in in model-launched CLI environments.
findings.R2: Join every canonical goal row to its measurement in one SQL statement; parsing uses that snapshot rather than a later database read. Covers detail/list/root/tree/children plus overdue, dependency, escalation and Brief projections.

regressions.coverage: Existing environment inventory plus nine deterministic reader/writer races. A separate process runs the real canonical writer after the reader fetches its goal rows, before projection.
regressions.command: bun test src/goals/measurements.test.ts src/util/model-exec-env.test.ts --test-name-pattern 'read keeps one measurement snapshot|each is either a daemon secret'

review_corrections.scope: Each goal is internally consistent. Recursive trees retain their existing behavior across different goals; this does not add a global tree snapshot or hierarchy rollup.
review_corrections.publication: Push to the same F15 PR #796; exact commit, normal hook results and current CI status are reported in the PR. Keep open and unmerged.
